# Boris FX

> Award-winning visual effects, audio production, and creative software tools for post-production professionals and content creators.

Boris FX provides a comprehensive suite of VFX plugins, rotoscoping tools, motion tracking software, and professional audio DAWs used across the film, television, and digital media industries. The company offers both integrated product suites and standalone tools compatible with major editing and compositing platforms.

## Key Topics

- VFX plugins
- Motion tracking
- Rotoscoping
- Particle effects
- Compositing
- Audio restoration
- Professional DAW
- Planar tracking
- 3D tracking
- Cinematic effects
- Video editing
- Motion graphics
- Academy Award-winning
- Adobe compatible
- Avid compatible

## Product Suites & Bundles

- [Boris FX Suite](https://borisfx.com/products/bfxsuite): Complete product suite including Continuum, Mocha Pro, Silhouette, and more
- [Compare Products](https://borisfx.com/products/compare-products): Product comparison tool for Continuum, Sapphire, and Mocha Pro

## VFX & Compositing Plugins

- [Sapphire](https://borisfx.com/products/sapphire): Award-winning VFX plugin suite with essential effects for Adobe, Avid, and OFX hosts
- [Continuum](https://borisfx.com/products/continuum): Comprehensive plugin suite with Particle Illusion, Title Studio, and 200+ effects
- [Optics](https://borisfx.com/products/optics): Photo editing and cinematic effects plugin for Adobe Photoshop and Lightroom

## Motion Tracking & Rotoscoping

- [Mocha Pro](https://borisfx.com/products/mocha-pro): Academy Award-winning planar tracking and VFX software with PowerMesh technology
- [SynthEyes](https://borisfx.com/products/syntheyes): Production-grade 3D tracking and camera solving software for VFX
- [Silhouette](https://borisfx.com/products/silhouette): Industry-standard rotoscoping and paint software for VFX compositing

## Motion Graphics & Particles

- [Particle Illusion](https://borisfx.com/products/particle-illusion): Fast and easy-to-use 3D particle generator for motion graphics and visual effects

## Professional Audio Software

- [Sequoia](https://borisfx.com/products/sequoia): Industry-leading DAW for professional mastering and broadcast audio
- [Samplitude](https://borisfx.com/products/samplitude): Professional DAW for audio recording, editing, and mastering
- [CrumplePop](https://borisfx.com/products/crumplepop): AI-powered audio restoration and enhancement toolkit for professional audio workflows
